svg.text: SwiftUI · MVVM + Use Cases · Supabase (cloud Postgres) · WidgetKit + ActivityKit extension sharing an App Group
UC3 · Glances at Home Screen widget /
Rule: a check-in must contain the
7 daily entries → ticks over at midnight
READ-ONLY · no network · never calls Supabase
Renders ContentState pushed by the app's
Data arrives via ActivityKit — not the App Group
App Group keys + countdown maths (W + R)
→ app and extension compile the same types
so the data shape can't drift
PRIMARY USE CASE — UC1 Record Period Symptoms: user action → database → back to the user
Athlete taps “Yes” on “Were you on your period?” (or picks a mood,
moves the intensity slider, types in the journal) in DayPollView.
The binding's setter calls TrackingStore.update(day) — the UC1 entry
point, shared by Home, Calendar and Journal.
UC1 mutates PollAnswers in memory; @Published reviews re-renders
the cycle ring, calendar and journal instantly (optimistic UI).
lastPeriodDate + cycleLength to the App Group, then reloadTimelines.
The widget's TimelineProvider reads the App Group and shows
“N days till ur period” — UC3 without opening the app.
After a 600 ms debounce (one request per burst of typing), UC1 calls
PeriodTRepository signs in anonymously if needed, then upserts
daily_reviews ON CONFLICT (user_id, day); RLS fills user_id.
Success: the UI is already correct. Failure: onFailure → presentError
→ error card, local edit kept so the athlete can retry.
Back: on launch, tab switch or pull-to-refresh, TrackingStore.load →
fetchPollAnswers → SELECT own rows → reviews → every view.
UC1 write path: user action → Supabase (① ② ⑥ ⑦)
Read / response path back to the user (③ ⑧ ⑨)
App Group shared container: app writes, widget reads (④ ⑤)
Business rules are shown in red italics inside each use case.
The extension never calls Supabase: the widget only reads the App Group,
and the Live Activity only receives state the app pushes through ActivityKit.
Dashed grey = Xcode template code that stores no data.
